Gstarsoft

Suzhou Gstarsoft Co., Ltd. (SSE: 688657) — Global Pioneer of High-Performance Industrial CAD, Cloud Collaboration & GRX Developer Ecosystems

1. Corporate Heritage, STAR Market IPO & Global R&D Footprint

Suzhou Gstarsoft Co., Ltd. (苏州浩辰软件股份有限公司, Stock Code: SSE: 688657) stands as a global leader in industrial computer-aided design (CAD) and cloud-enabled engineering collaboration software. Tracing its core technical origins to Tsinghua University CAD R&D initiatives in 1992 and formally incorporated in Suzhou Industrial Park in 2001, Gstarsoft went public on the Shanghai Stock Exchange Science and Technology Innovation Board (STAR Market) in October 2023.

With six global R&D centers across Suzhou, Beijing, Xi'an, and international technical hubs, Gstarsoft serves over 100 countries and regions and powers more than 70 million global users through its flagship desktop platform (GstarCAD) and cloud/mobile ecosystem (DWG FastView). Unlike single-product CAD resellers, Gstarsoft owns an independent dual-core graphics engine, a multi-threaded DWG database scheduler, and a source-level C++ ObjectARX-compatible runtime (GRX SDK).

2. Proprietary Graphics Kernel, AC1032 Binary Pipeline & GRX SDK Architecture

The technical moat of GstarCAD 2027 lies in its multi-core graphics vectorization engine and zero-loss binary DWG storage pipeline. Rather than translating DWG files into an intermediate database—which corrupts extended entity data (XData), custom proxy dictionaries, and dynamic block lookup tables—GstarCAD reads and writes native AC1015 through AC1032 (R2000–R2027) binary streams directly.

  • Parallel Display List & Spatial R-Tree Indexing: Controlled via WHIPTHREAD = 3 and INDEXCTL = 3, GstarCAD partitions model-space octrees across modern multi-core CPUs, maintaining 60+ FPS pan/zoom frame rates even on dense civil grading maps or wafer-fab MEP drawings exceeding 1,000,000 entities.
  • Tri-Layer API Compatibility for Global ISVs: Through the C++ GRX SDK (source-level equivalent to ObjectARX), C# .NET Managed API (GsMgd.dll, GsDbMgd.dll under Gssoft.GstarCAD.* namespaces), and native AutoLISP / Visual LISP / ActiveX COM, third-party developers recompile legacy AutoCAD plugins in hours rather than months.
  • Vertical Industry Specialization: GstarCAD Mechanical natively supports ACM-compatible part references, automated BOM balloons, and ISO/DIN/ANSI/JIS/GB standard parts, while GstarCAD Architecture provides parametric 2D/3D walls, slabs, stairs, and automated section generation.

3. Enterprise Perpetual Licensing Sovereignty & 5-Year TCO Advantage

In an era where legacy CAD vendors enforce mandatory annual subscriptions and rigid Named-User auditing, Suzhou Gstarsoft Co., Ltd. champions Customer Licensing Sovereignty. Enterprises can choose between Perpetual Standalone Locks, GstarLM Network Floating Pools (supporting multi-subnet WAN and offline laptop borrowing), or flexible annual subscriptions. Over a standard 5-year IT depreciation cycle, migrating 100 to 1,000 seats from AutoCAD to GstarCAD preserves 75% to 85% of total software capital with zero retraining downtime.
